classification_basis: Objective PESQ stayed within 0.05 while same-lane speed improved by at least 10% or deployable size fell by at least 45%.
Dense masking caused more than 0.10 PESQ loss and provides no physical storage or sparse-kernel deployment gain.
Dense masked tensors do not establish deployable acceleration or storage reduction even when objective quality is retained.
The measured quality–speed–size trade-off does not cross the descriptive benefit or harm thresholds.
